context_for_next_testing_agent: Permission system fully implemented and tested. Key points: (1) DEFAULT_MANAGER_PERMISSIONS = 7 permissions (members_view, members_create, members_edit, payments_register, pos_sell, access_view, classes_manage). (3) Permission checks use check_permission() in backend which reads from DB on each request. (4) Frontend uses hasPermission() from AuthContext which checks admin.permissions array.
